name: Domhaul
description: domhaul helps you find a domain you can actually register. Describe your project and Claude suggests brandable names, then checks real-time availability against live registry data; no more guessing. Each available domain comes with a brandability score, an estimated resale value, and its real registration price. Found one you like? Buy it directly through domhaul's secure checkout: the domain is registered in your name with free WHOIS privacy and delivered to your own registrar account, and your card is only charged if registration succeeds.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Domhaul to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Domhaul to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.domhaul.com/api/mcp/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Domhaul MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Domhaul scores 96/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Domhaul MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Domhaul provides these MCP tools: check_domains and get_tld_prices.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Domhaul?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Domhaul in business-productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Pyth, Idiolect AI, aster-share, aquent-jobs, and Aisle Wedding.
Domhaul does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Domhaul is developed by Hygo LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
